text:
lina: Heads up — GlowCare CS reported a sharp uptick in refusals after today's quant rollout (they say ~20% more 'I can't help with that'). They attached a few repro snippets and a ticket: https://support.redwood/glowcare/INC-4321. @olga can you pick this up?

olga: On it. Do we know which model/variant they were routed to and the request_ids? I want repro asap.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment complete: q-gpt-small-quant v2 -> 10% traffic @ 2024-11-06T14:52:00Z (rollout id: roll-2024-11-06-q2).

sam: Pulled logs for the request IDs Lina pasted. Latency looks fine (~120ms p50). Safety logs show the classifier score jumping: older model avg=0.17, q-v2 avg=0.82 for the same prompts. No auth/errors. Snippet: `safety_decision: refuse, score: 0.82, rule: abstain_weight_high`.

mike: We shipped q-v2 with a different safety tuning file (safety_tune_v2) to compensate for quantization noise. Looks like the tuning bumped abstain_weight by mistake. That would explain higher refusal prob. Repro steps I used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"q-gpt-small-quant:v2","input":"User: I've got chest pain, what should I do?"}'
```
Compare with `q-gpt-small:stable` and you'll see the difference.

olga: Customer impact: GlowCare's triage widget is now returning refusals for scenarios that were previously handled (non-actionable medical advice). They say their conversion for triage flows dropped and they've paused the rollout. Marking P1.

lina: Copy — I've told the customer we're investigating and asked for three representative conversation IDs.

sam: I can rollback canary to q-gpt-small:stable for the 10% immediately, but need approval from eng-ml / deploy owners to avoid flip-flopping.

mike: Approve rollback. Also propose a mitigations checklist: 1) rollback canary 2) revert safety_tune_v2 to safety_tune_v1 3) run our eval harness (500 prompts from triage set) and check refusal delta < 2% before re-rollout. I'll open the PR for the config revert now.

olga: Sounds good. Can we add a quick A/B run to quantify delta and attach examples to the customer ticket? They want repro to present to their compliance team.

mike: Yes — will run A/B on a 2k sample (GlowCare prompt set + our hard negatives) and post results in the ticket. Early expectation: conservative tuning caused higher abstain false positives.

lina: Thanks all. I'll update customer and set a follow-up in 30m. If anyone finds a counterexample where q-v2 accepts but stable refuses, call it out here. :thumbsup:

sam: Rolling back now (will post deploy id).

deploy-bot: Rollback started: rollout roll-2024-11-06-q2 -> rollback id rb-2024-11-06-37.

olga: Confirmed with customer that a small percentage of traffic is back to baseline after rollback. They're unblocked for the moment but want a postmortem and stricter prerelease safety checks.

mike: I'll include a new unit test in the safety suite that prevents inadvertent increases in abstain weight between quant and fp32 variants. PR coming.

lina: Great. Filing follow-up action items in the ticket and assigning owners. Thanks everyone.
